title: Grade consistency across a set
description: Grade a reference frame, have reviewers call outliers independently, tally the calls so a contested frame stays contested, and loop the rework until the set holds.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-photo-04
  title: Grade consistency across a set
  description: Grade a reference frame, have reviewers call outliers independently, tally the calls so
    a contested frame stays contested, and loop the rework until the set holds.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Deliver a set that reads as one body of work, with every outlier called by evidence and contested
    frames resolved rather than averaged into an acceptable middle.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: The set and its output medium
      summary: The set and its output medium
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - assets
          - instructions
        properties:
          assets:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            maxItems: 12
            items:
              type: object
              required:
                - uri
                - mediaType
              properties:
                uri:
                  type: string
                  description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier,
                    or authorized HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
                mediaType:
                  type: string
                  pattern: ^(image|audio|video|application)/
                name:
                  type: string
          instructions:
            type: string
          sourceRights:
            type: string
            description: User-supplied rights, consent, release, or provenance context when relevant.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - reference_frame
              - output_medium
              - colour_space
              - coherence_threshold
            properties:
              reference_frame: {}
              output_medium: {}
              colour_space: {}
              coherence_threshold: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: n-reference
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-05
      name: Establish the reference grade
      summary: Establish the reference the rest of the set is judged against.
      role: Colourist judging white balance, tonal structure, skin, and consistency across a set.
      prompt: You are a Colour & Tone Grading Reviewer. You judge white balance and tonal structure against
        the intent and the output medium, pay particular attention to skin rendering and to colour casts
        that only show in the neutrals, and you check a set for grade drift frame to frame rather than
        judging each picture alone. You state which of your observations depend on the display and colour
        space the file was prepared for, because a grade that is wrong on a calibrated display and a grade
        that is wrong only on this viewer are different problems.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-review1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-05
      name: Colour and tone consistency call
      summary: Judges grade drift across the set. Called independently of the other reviewers.
      role: Colourist judging white balance, tonal structure, skin, and consistency across a set.
      prompt: You are a Colour & Tone Grading Reviewer. You judge white balance and tonal structure against
        the intent and the output medium, pay particular attention to skin rendering and to colour casts
        that only show in the neutrals, and you check a set for grade drift frame to frame rather than
        judging each picture alone. You state which of your observations depend on the display and colour
        space the file was prepared for, because a grade that is wrong on a calibrated display and a grade
        that is wrong only on this viewer are different problems.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - outlier_frames
          - dimension
          - evidence
        properties:
          outlier_frames: {}
          dimension: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-review2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-01
      name: Light and exposure consistency call
      summary: Judges exposure and contrast drift. Called independently of the other reviewers.
      role: Critic reading the light in a frame — quality, direction, ratio, and what the exposure protected.
      prompt: 'You are a Lighting & Exposure Critic. You describe the light actually in the frame — its
        quality, direction, ratio, and colour — and judge the exposure by what it protected and what it
        gave up, not by a histogram shape: a deliberately low-key frame with crushed shadows and a badly
        underexposed one look similar in a thumbnail and are not the same picture. You judge against the
        photographer''s stated intent and the conventions of the genre, you name the region you are talking
        about, and you say plainly when the file you were given — a small preview, a baked JPEG, no EXIF
        — cannot support the judgement being asked of you.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - outlier_frames
          - dimension
          - evidence
        properties:
          outlier_frames: {}
          dimension: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-review3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-04
      name: Technical consistency call
      summary: Judges sharpening and noise treatment drift. Called independently of the other reviewers.
      role: Inspector separating technical faults from stylistic choices in sharpness, motion, and noise.
      prompt: 'You are a Focus & Technical Quality Inspector. You assess focus placement and depth of
        field against what the picture is about, and you distinguish the causes that look alike at a glance
        — missed focus, subject motion, camera shake, diffraction, over-sharpening, aggressive noise reduction
        — because each one has a different fix and a different prevention. You separate a fault from a
        choice: motion blur on a moving subject may be the picture, and you say which reading the evidence
        in the frame supports rather than defaulting to ''soft''.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - video-processing
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - outlier_frames
          - dimension
          - evidence
        properties:
          outlier_frames: {}
          dimension: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-outliers
      kind: aggregator
      name: Tally the outlier calls
      summary: Tally which frames were called outliers; a frame flagged by one reviewer and cleared by
        another stays a tie rather than being averaged away.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-coherence
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Score set coherence
      summary: Evaluate grade coherence across the set and skin rendering consistency on the output medium.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against grade coherence across the set and skin rendering consistency
        on the output medium. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict, remaining
        uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement unless
        the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: n-consistent
      kind: condition
      name: Set reads as one body of work?
      summary: Route on coherence.passed.
      config:
        expression: coherence.passed
        branches:
          - label: Consistent
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework outliers
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-regrade
      kind: loop
      name: Rework the outlier frames
      summary: Repeat a bounded revision sequence until the set clears the declared coherence threshold
        on the stated output medium.
      config:
        body:
          - n-reference
          - n-review1
          - n-review2
          - n-review3
          - n-outliers
          - n-coherence
          - n-consistent
        exitCondition: the set clears the declared coherence threshold on the stated output medium
        maxIterations: 3
        onExhausted: stop
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Photographer accepts the graded set
      summary: Pause for the photographer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Grade consistency across a set deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-reference
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-2
      from: n-reference
      to: n-review1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-3
      from: n-reference
      to: n-review2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-4
      from: n-reference
      to: n-review3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-5
      from: n-review1
      to: n-outliers
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-6
      from: n-review2
      to: n-outliers
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-7
      from: n-review3
      to: n-outliers
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-8
      from: n-outliers
      to: n-coherence
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-9
      from: n-coherence
      to: n-consistent
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-10
      from: n-consistent
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-11
      from: n-consistent
      to: n-regrade
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-12
      from: n-regrade
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: wf-photo-04-edge-13
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
